verdict.rationale: Jira's own integrations page documents syncing Trello with Jira Software, which brings one other project-management tool's work into Jira. Its enterprise search also spans Jira and connected apps from a single search bar. Neither is documented as a consolidated 'my assigned tasks' view across several PM tools; the search is a related feature and gets no credit on its own. Missing for 10: a documented unified assigned-work view, support for multiple external PM tools beyond Trello, details on how synced assignments appear, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see my assigned tasks from multiple project management tools in one unified view

citations.quote: Collaborate across tools with transparency and create workflows that work for you by syncing Trello and Jira Software.
Use enterprise search to find anything across Jira, Confluence, and any connected app from a single search bar.
